name: Cairne's Hoofprint
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
They say that Cairne Bloodhoof is one of the greatest heroes the Horde has ever seen.  When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Horde too!

Do you know Cairne, adventurer?  Could you do me a favor, please?  Could you get his hoofprint for me?  I dunno how to ask him, and he'd probably be too busy for someone like me... but you!  You're an adventurer just like he is!  I bet he'd give you his hoofprint easy!

Please?
narrative.objectives: Travel to Thunder Bluff to see about getting Cairne Bloodhoof's hoofprint for your ward.
narrative.offerRewardText:
WOW! You got Cairne's hoofprint for me! Thank you very much! And wow... he wrote a personal message on here - to me! I knew he'd be totally cool, I just did! Maybe someday I'll thank him myself... when I become a hero of the Horde!

You're the best, adventurer. Thank you for being so nice to me.
narrative.requestItemsText: When the orcs were alone and without friends, the tauren welcomed them to a strange land and shared with them without asking anything in return. That's honor, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 2,300 XP in all.
